skills.name: glitztype
skills.description: Make retro WordArt text as Glitztype links, a name or word in one of twelve styles that opens at glitztype.yolopreneur.lol with the whole piece inside the link and nothing uploaded. Use when asked for WordArt, a styled name or word, a banner or sign title, or a transparent-PNG text sticker to open in a browser or share as a link.
